floater.name: env_adjust_snapshot
floater.title: Personal Lighting
floater.string: Intensity of lighting effects such as realistically bright skies and dynamic exposure. 1.0 is the default, 0 is off, values between 0 and 1 are mixing Ambient with HDR.
Classic sky: sky sliders inactive (Local lights EV still applies)

This is a classic (pre-PBR) sky: a legacy sky with "auto-adjust legacy skies" (RenderSkyAutoAdjustLegacy) turned off. Classic shading mixes sun and ambient in gamma space, where a stop-based factor cannot be applied correctly, so the Sun / Moon, GI, probe, tint and shadow-lift controls are inactive on it. Local lights (EV) still applies: local lights are added after that mix, in linear light. Turn RenderSkyAutoAdjustLegacy on, or use a sky with Reflection Probe Ambiance above 0, to use the rest.
Legacy sky: Sun boost above 0 EV has no effect

This sky has no Reflection Probe Ambiance (legacy / non-HDR), so it skips the tonemapper: Sun / Moon boosts above 0 EV would clip and are capped at 0 EV. Negative values still work. Set Reflection Probe Ambiance above 0 to enable boosts.

button.label: Reset
button.tool_tip: Close and reset to Shared Environment
button.name: btn_reset

text.name: probe_ambiance_label
text.tool_tip: Irradiance control. When not zero, enables HDR lighting model.

slider.name: probe_ambiance
slider.tool_tip: Intensity of environment based indirect lighting. At zero HDR scale becomes Brightness

layout_panel.name: lp_env_intensity

text.name: env_intensity_label
text.tool_tip: Viewer-side light intensity offsets applied on top of the current sky. Saved with your viewer settings, persist across skies and are never written into the sky (EEP) asset.

check_box.label: Auto exposure
check_box.name: env_auto_exposure
check_box.tool_tip: Dynamic (auto) exposure. It partially compensates intensity changes (about 2 stops of range), so the sliders feel softer in dim scenes. Turn it off for a fixed exposure and exact slider control. S-Log3 capture already ignores it. Viewer setting, not saved into the sky.

text.name: env_sun_ev_label
text.tool_tip: Direct sun / moon light on surfaces, in stops (EV). 0.00 = the sky's stock level.

slider.name: env_sun_ev
slider.tool_tip: Sun intensity offset in stops (2^EV: +1.00 doubles, -1.00 halves); also the moon while 'Link to Sun' is on (Advanced). 0.00 = the sky's stock level, range -4 to +6; above about +3 the tonemapper pushes lit surfaces to white. Wheel: 0.05 per notch, Shift 0.01, Ctrl/Alt 0.5. Viewer-side: saved with your settings, persists across skies, never written into the sky (EEP). Scales direct light on surfaces only; the sun disc, sky dome, clouds and volumetric shafts keep their level. Material thumbnails follow Sun/Moon EV and colour via the sky probe. On legacy (non-HDR) skies boosts above 0 EV are capped (no tonemapper); darkening still works. Inactive on classic skies (legacy sky with auto-adjust off).

button.name: env_sun_ev_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset Sun / Moon to 0.00 EV (the sky's stock level)

text.name: env_gi_ev_label
text.tool_tip: Sky light / indirect (reflection-probe GI) light on surfaces, in stops (EV). 0.00 = the sky's stock level.

slider.name: env_gi_ev
slider.tool_tip: Sky light / GI master offset in stops (2^EV: +1.00 doubles, -1.00 halves). 0.00 = the sky's stock level, range -4 to +4. Wheel: 0.05 per notch, Shift 0.01, Ctrl/Alt 0.5. Viewer-side: saved with your settings, persists across skies, never written into the sky (EEP). Scales sky ambient and reflection-probe irradiance together (each with its own Advanced offset), so it works with probes on or off. Display-time factor: applied when surfaces are shaded, held at stock inside probe captures. Probe reflections have their own Advanced slider (that multiplier is the one skipped by mirrors and screen-space reflections). The sky dome itself keeps its level. Inactive on classic skies (legacy sky with auto-adjust off).

button.name: env_gi_ev_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset Sky light (GI) to 0.00 EV (the sky's stock level)

text.name: env_legacy_sun_note
text.tool_tip: This sky has no Reflection Probe Ambiance (legacy / non-HDR), so it skips the tonemapper: Sun / Moon boosts above 0 EV would clip and are capped at 0 EV. Negative values still work. Set Reflection Probe Ambiance above 0 to enable boosts.

layout_panel.text: Legacy sky: Sun boost above 0 EV has no effect

text.name: env_intensity_hint
text.tool_tip: Auto exposure adapts to scene brightness (about 2 stops of range) and so partially compensates the sliders; turn it off for exact control. Every control on this strip is a viewer-side multiplier: not saved into the sky, and the sun disc / sky dome do not change with them. Hover a slider and scroll: one increment per notch, Shift for a fine step, Ctrl or Alt for x10.

layout_panel.text: Auto exposure partially compensates (~2 stops): turn it off for exact control. Viewer-side only, not saved into the sky.

combo_box.name: env_intensity_preset
combo_box.tool_tip: Quick Presets: apply a named Light Intensity look (writes the Sun/Moon/GI/local-light EV, Kelvin, tints and shadow lift sliders in one step). Viewer-side only, never written into the sky; changing any slider afterward switches this back to Custom.

button.label: Advanced +
button.name: env_adv_toggle
button.tool_tip: Show or hide the Advanced exposure panel: Moon link, GI split (sky ambient / probe diffuse / probe reflections), Local lights EV, Sun temperature, Sun / Moon / Ambient tints and Shadow lift. Persists across sessions.

layout_panel.name: lp_env_intensity_adv

text.name: env_moon_ev_label
text.tool_tip: Direct moon light on surfaces at night, in stops (EV). Only used while 'Link to Sun' is off.

check_box.label: Link to Sun
check_box.name: env_moon_linked
check_box.tool_tip: On (default): the Sun / Moon slider above drives both the sun and the moon. Off: the Moon slider takes over at night; the Sun slider then reads 'Sun (EV)'.

slider.name: env_moon_ev
slider.tool_tip: Moon intensity offset in stops (2^EV), applied to direct moon light on surfaces while the moon is the primary light and 'Link to Sun' is off. 0.00 = stock, range -4 to +6. The moon disc and sky dome keep their level. Legacy-sky cap and classic-sky rules as for the Sun. Viewer-side, never written into the sky.

text.name: env_local_ev_label
text.tool_tip: World point / spot / projector lights, in stops (EV).

check_box.label: incl. rig lights
check_box.name: env_local_include_rig
check_box.tool_tip: Also scale the Cine Light Rig's own emitters by Local lights (EV). Off (default): rig lights keep their own controls and are not scaled, so the rig look and Rig Rim stay put.

slider.name: env_local_ev
slider.tool_tip: Local light intensity offset in stops (2^EV) for every world point / spot / projector light (deferred, forward, volumetric shafts, cine live probe and Prism views), on top of the Lightbox global light scale. 0.00 = stock, range -4 to +4. Active in probe captures (it scales the source light once) and on classic skies. Cine Light Rig emitters are excluded unless 'incl. rig lights' is on. Viewer-side, never written into the sky.

text.name: env_probe_diff_ev_label
text.tool_tip: Reflection-probe irradiance (indirect diffuse), in stops (EV), on top of the GI master.

slider.name: env_probe_diff_ev
slider.tool_tip: Reflection-probe irradiance (indirect diffuse) offset in stops (2^EV), added to the Sky light (GI) master; with probes off it scales the sky-ambient fallback instead. Also scales the SSAO irradiance ceiling so corners track open shadow. 0.00 = stock, range -3 to +3; the sum with the master is clamped to +-6. Held at stock during probe captures (applied once, at display). Viewer-side, never written into the sky.

text.name: env_probe_spec_ev_label
text.tool_tip: Reflection-probe radiance (glossy / metal / water reflections), in stops (EV). Independent of the GI master.

slider.name: env_probe_spec_ev
slider.tool_tip: Reflection-probe radiance offset in stops (2^EV): glossy, metal, water, legacy shiny and env-mapped reflections. Independent of the GI master. Applied before the screen-space and mirror mixes, so SSR streaks and hero mirrors skip this multiplier (they still show the other light settings). 0.00 = stock, range -3 to +3. Held at stock during probe captures. Viewer-side, never written into the sky.

text.name: env_amb_ev_label
text.tool_tip: Sky ambient (EEP ambient) light on surfaces, in stops (EV), on top of the GI master.

slider.name: env_amb_ev
slider.tool_tip: Sky ambient (EEP ambient) offset in stops (2^EV), added to the Sky light (GI) master. 0.00 = stock, range -3 to +3; the sum with the master is clamped to +-6. Held at stock during probe captures (the probes bake it once). The sky dome keeps its level. Viewer-side, never written into the sky.

text.name: env_shadow_lift_label
text.tool_tip: Raises the ambient / indirect term where the sun or moon does not reach, in stops (EV).

slider.name: env_shadow_lift
slider.tool_tip: Shadow lift in stops: full shadow gets its ambient / indirect light multiplied by 2^EV (+1.00 = x2), pixels the sun or moon lights at more than 25% (NdotL x shadow) are exactly unchanged, and the terminator ramps in between. Applied after the SSAO ceiling so occluded corners lift by the same ratio as open shadow; baked material AO still applies. 0.00 = off, range 0 to +2. Off in classic mode and in probe captures. Water, fullbright and emissive are untouched. Viewer-side, never written into the sky.

text.name: env_sun_kelvin_label
text.tool_tip: Colour temperature of direct sun light on surfaces. 6500 K = no change.

slider.name: env_sun_kelvin
slider.tool_tip: Sun colour temperature in Kelvin (Planckian locus, applied in linear light). 6500 = exact identity; lower is warmer, higher is cooler. Luminance-preserving: a neutral sun keeps its brightness, only its colour changes (brightness belongs to the EV sliders). Range 2000 to 12000; wheel 50 per notch, Shift 10, Ctrl/Alt 500. Affects direct sun light on surfaces only, not the sun disc, sky dome, clouds, moon or local lights. On legacy (non-HDR) skies the tint is normalised so no channel exceeds stock. Viewer-side, never written into the sky.

button.name: env_sun_kelvin_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset Sun temperature to 6500 K (no change)

text.name: env_sun_tint_label
text.tool_tip: Tint on direct sun light (swatch + strength). White or strength 0 = no tint; Kelvin still applies.

color_swatch.name: env_sun_tint_swatch
color_swatch.tool_tip: Sun tint colour (sRGB picker). Multiplies direct sun light on surfaces after the Kelvin shift, luminance-normalised: a neutral sun keeps its brightness and only gains colour (max channel 4x). White = no tint. Not the sun disc, sky, specular or local lights. Viewer-side, never written into the sky.

slider.name: env_sun_tint_strength
slider.tool_tip: Sun tint strength 0 to 1: scales only the swatch term (Kelvin is always fully applied). 0 = no swatch tint. Wheel 0.01 per notch, Shift 0.002, Ctrl/Alt 0.1.

button.name: env_sun_tint_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset Sun tint to white, strength 1 (no tint)

text.name: env_moon_tint_label
text.tool_tip: Tint on direct moon light at night (swatch + strength). White or strength 0 = no tint.

color_swatch.name: env_moon_tint_swatch
color_swatch.tool_tip: Moon tint colour (sRGB picker). Multiplies direct moon light on surfaces at night, luminance-normalised (max channel 4x). White = no tint. Not the moon disc, sky, specular or local lights. Viewer-side, never written into the sky.

slider.name: env_moon_tint_strength
slider.tool_tip: Moon tint strength 0 to 1. 0 = no tint. Wheel 0.01 per notch, Shift 0.002, Ctrl/Alt 0.1.

button.name: env_moon_tint_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset Moon tint to white, strength 1 (no tint)

text.name: env_amb_tint_label
text.tool_tip: Tint on sky ambient and probe irradiance (shadow side, interiors, corners). White or strength 0 = no tint.

color_swatch.name: env_amb_tint_swatch
color_swatch.tool_tip: Ambient tint colour (sRGB picker). Multiplies sky ambient, reflection-probe irradiance and the SSAO ceiling (the shadow side, probe-lit interiors, corners), luminance-normalised (max channel 4x). Not the sky dome, reflections, local lights or emissive. White = no tint; held at stock during probe captures. Viewer-side, never written into the sky.

slider.name: env_amb_tint_strength
slider.tool_tip: Ambient tint strength 0 to 1. 0 = no tint. Wheel 0.01 per notch, Shift 0.002, Ctrl/Alt 0.1.

button.name: env_amb_tint_reset
button.tool_tip: Reset Ambient tint to white, strength 1 (no tint)

button.label: Reset advanced
button.name: env_adv_reset_all
button.tool_tip: Reset every Advanced control to its default (Moon linked to Sun, all offsets 0 EV, 6500 K, white tints at strength 1, shadow lift off). The two master sliders above are not touched.

text.name: env_adv_note
text.tool_tip: Probe reflections (EV) is independent of the Sky light (GI) master: the master scales sky ambient and probe diffuse only. Mirrors and screen-space reflections skip the Probe reflections multiplier (they are mixed in after it). Two kinds of factor: source-light factors (Sun / Moon EV, Sun temperature, Sun / Moon tint, Local lights EV) scale the light itself, so they also reach probe captures and mirrors through the lit scene; display-time factors (GI master, Sky ambient, Probe diffuse, Probe reflections, Ambient tint, Shadow lift) are applied only when surfaces are shaded and held at stock inside probe captures, so they act exactly once. Legacy (non-HDR) skies: tints only ever dim channels. Material thumbnails follow the source-light factors via the sky probe.

layout_panel.text: Probe reflections (EV) is independent of the GI master; mirrors / SSR skip that multiplier.

combo_box.name: sky_preset_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Type a name to save a local sky preset, or select a preset to load
